findings.evidence: l.149-154: `def re ... mat := ρ.mat.map Complex.re`; `mat_re : ρ.re.mat = ρ.mat.map Complex.re := rfl`. `PDF.f1_add_g1 ρ.re : PDF.f1 ρ.re + PDF.g1 ρ.re = ρ.re.mat idxPP idxPP + ρ.re.mat idxMM idxMM` (Positivity.lean:156) is accepted at the stated type `... = (ρ.mat idxPP idxPP).re + (ρ.mat idxMM idxMM).re` with no rewriting.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] lemma mat_re_apply (i j) : ρ.re.mat i j = (ρ.mat i j).re := rfl` and route these five proofs through it together with `f1_re`/`g1_re` (e.g. `by rw [← f1_re, ← g1_re]; simpa using PDF.f1_add_g1 ρ.re`), so the defeq is confined to one stated lemma.
findings.issue: `f1_add_deltaQ := PDF.f1_add_g1 ρ.re` (and `f1_sub_deltaQ` l.176, `f1_eq_of_parityInvariant` l.247, `deltaQ_eq_of_parityInvariant` l.253, `IsParityInvariant.re` l.241 via `congrArg Complex.re`) typecheck only because `ρ.re.mat i j` unfolds definitionally to `(ρ.mat i j).re` through the `re` field and `Matrix.map`. No lemma states that entrywise equality: `mat_re` only gives `ρ.re.mat = ρ.mat.map Complex.re`, so the step from there to the entry is undocumented defeq across the wrapper.

findings.evidence: Three occurrences of `simpa using ρ.posSemidef.1.apply` at lines 262, 281, 305; `Matrix.IsHermitian.apply` is `star (A j i) = A i j` (mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Hermitian.lean:63).
findings.fix: Hoist it: `lemma conj_mat_apply (i j : Fin 4) : conj (ρ.mat i j) = ρ.mat j i := by simpa using ρ.posSemidef.1.apply j i`, and use it in all three proofs.
findings.issue: The reusable fact `conj (ρ.mat i j) = ρ.mat j i` is proved inline three times: as `hconj` in `isTimeReversalInvariant_iff_isSymm` (l.304-305), and at single index pairs in `IsParityInvariant.im_transversity` (l.261-262) and `isParityInvariant_iff` (l.280-281), each as `simpa using ρ.posSemidef.1.apply _ _`. The file already exposes the analogous diagonal fact as `coe_re_mat_apply_self`.

summary: Proofs are short, automation-based, and free of change/show, but five term-mode proofs typecheck only through an unstated entrywise defeq of SpinDensityC.re, and the hermiticity relation conj (mat i j) = mat j i is re-derived inline three times instead of being a lemma.
